description.en: Fractal, dockable workspace layouts with deep panel nesting and infinite zoom.
description.zh: 支持无限层级分形嵌套、平滑缩放与持久挂载视图的高性能 Web 停靠工作区布局引擎。

content.en: Trellis is a modern layout engine created by Dan Fessler for complex web tools, creative software, and IDEs. It introduces a fractal workspace model where tabbed panels can nest infinitely within other panels and users can zoom freely between high-level stages and granular sub-workspaces. Crucially, all views remain mounted through moves, splits, and floating transitions—preserving canvas state, WebGL contexts, form inputs, and audio playback.
content.zh: Trellis 是由 Dan Fessler 专为复杂 Web 专业工具、创作软件与 IDE 打造的现代化工作区布局引擎。它创新性地采用了「分形嵌套」架构，面板内部可无限层级嵌套子工作区，并支持平滑缩放视图，让用户随时在全局概览与微观细节间自由穿梭。尤为关键的是，无论面板在标签页合并、分栏切分还是浮动窗口之间如何移动，视图的 DOM 节点与运行时状态都将始终保持挂载（Keep-Alive），完整保留 Canvas 画布、WebGL 绘图上下文、输入焦点与音频播放状态。
